1084540807-us.title: Great concept… ruined by a lack of difficulty customization.
1084540807-us.text:
The concept is great. The lock screen widget is great. The app is overall well designed and easy to use. However, there absolutely needs be a way to fine-tune the difficulty beyond “beginner, intermediate, advanced.” 

I found the intermediate difficulty vocabulary to be far too easy - there were almost no words filed under intermediate that I didn’t both already know and feel comfortable using. The advanced category on the other hand is filled to the brim with ridiculous, often pseudo-old english words that I wouldn’t even *want* to learn in the first place. It was rare for me to encounter an advanced word that I would find at all applicable or even reasonably useable. In my opinion this app is in desperate need of something along the lines of a difficulty slider. At the very least an “intermediate-advanced” category should be added. 

If a feature that allows you to fine-tune the difficulty is added, I will change my review to 5 stars! The app is otherwise great.
